reviews.title: Great app but please fix syncing
reviews.contents: This app has been really handy to keep track of feeds and nappies! I love that you can add it as a widget to your Home Screen. However, we paid for the duo version but if one of us logs a bottle, it doesn’t update in the other persons app! This makes it tricky for timing when you rely on the app and paid a lot!

reviews.title: First time mum
reviews.contents: I am a first time to a ex premier baby and I was not sure what exercise I should do, how to track my wet nappies and poo but now after having this app for two days. I can interact with my baby more, exercises is my favourite part and also, milestones. I now know which milestones I should be expecting for my new born. It even has breast expression, feeding options to track how much you have expressed. I am so thankful to the creator of this app. may our Lord Jesus Bless you

reviews.title: So good!
reviews.contents: I just started using this app! I downloaded a few to compare them and so far this is great! The widget counts down when you last fed/changed/slept etc. thats so helpful! Andd the weekly rundowns of what to expect with baby is great! I was looking for something similar to tracking week to week pregnancy and a tracker thats straight forward and this app has it all! 5.5

reviews.title: Great way to learn and keep notes on Growth and Development
reviews.contents:
I’m learning so much from this all and it’s helping me engage more with my newborn in ways I never thought i could. I’m
Noticing the milestones and am able to keep track of it through the app and keep up with his growth

reviews.title: Needs more work!
reviews.contents:
Both Parents can’t use same account pretty useless in terms of that! Not paying twice!  Content ok but the leaps are not explained properly! 
Navigating isn’t simple either. Games/activitys are ok

reviews.title: Doesn’t calc corrected date
reviews.contents: App doesn’t allow for preterm baby. Doesn’t calculate corrected date for development. Asks for how many weeks they were born at but gives actual age meaning activities were for a 6 month old rather than a 2 month corrected. tried to add a 2nd baby just using her due date and it says date not recognised. Deleted app. Highly recommended by a friend though

reviews.title: Cursed app
reviews.contents: I installed this app and found the activities so basic and the same every day for months, so decided to delete. But it reinstalls itself on my phone every day. I have uninstalled it 15+ times in the past couple of weeks. I don’t know how to make it stay away. I even screen recorded myself deleting the app (not just from Home Screen but from whole phone) to make sure I wasn’t hallucinating.

reviews.title: Paid app
reviews.contents: This app is fully paid.. you can’t access without paying . from the free trial it looks okay and validates why bubba might be a bit cranky that week due to new skills emerging but otherwise not really helpful

reviews.title: New update loosing data
reviews.contents: The new update of this app is loosing tracked data. I’m putting in feeding data and after a while it’s getting lost and not shown in the statistics. It is annoying me cause I want to track the feeding

reviews.title: Not helpful
reviews.contents: I paid for the yearly subscription but deleted the apps. I don’t find this helpful. It is asking me to pay again when i downloaded the apps again. How do i get my refund or use the apps again since i have paid?
